info.name: OxideAuth
info.description:
Postman collection for the OxideAuth IAM API.

All endpoints return a standard JSON envelope:
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "status": 200,
  "data": { ... }
}
```

## Quick Start
1. Set the `host` variable to your API base URL (default: http://127.0.0.1:8000)
2. Obtain a Bearer token and set it in the `token` variable
3. Set a valid `workspace_id` to use across all endpoints

request.description:
### Root Index

Returns a simple greeting message. Used to verify the API is running.

#### Response

``` json
{
  "success": true,
  "status": 200,
  "data": "Hello, World"
}
```

### Health Check

Returns the health status of the API.

#### Response

``` json
{
  "success": true,
  "status": 200,
  "data": "Healthy"
}
```

item.name: Workspace
item.description:
Multi-tenant workspace management. Workspaces are the top-level organizational unit.

**Auth required:** Bearer token for all endpoints.

request.description:
### Create Workspace

Creates a new workspace (tenant). The slug must be globally unique.

#### Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| name | string | Yes | Display name of the workspace |
| slug | string | Yes | URL-friendly unique identifier |
| description | string | No | Optional description |
| config | object | Yes | Workspace configuration (must include `schema_version`) |
| tags | string[] | Yes | Tags for categorization |
| meta | object | Yes | Metadata (must include `schema_version`) |

#### Response

Returns the created workspace object with `id`, `name`, `slug`, `created_at`, etc.

### Describe Workspace

Retrieves a workspace by its `id` or `slug`.

#### Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| id | uuid | No* | Workspace ID (either id or slug required) |
| slug | string | No* | Workspace slug (either id or slug required) |

#### Response

Returns the full workspace object with all fields.

### List Workspaces

Lists all workspaces with optional filtering and pagination.

#### Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| filter | object | No | Filter params with `tags` (string[]) and `fields` (object with field filters) |
| options | object | No | Pagination: `limit` (int), `offset` (int), `order_bys` (string, e.g. "!created_at" for DESC) |

#### Filter Fields
- `id`: UUID filter
- `name`: string filter
- `slug`: string filter
- `description`: string filter

#### Response

``` json
{
  "success": true,
  "status": 200,
  "data": {
    "workspaces": [...],
    "metadata": {
      "total": 42,
      "count": 10,
      "offset": 0,
      "limit": 10,
      "order_bys": ["!created_at"]
    }
  }
}
```

### Update Workspace

Updates workspace fields. All fields are optional — only include what you want to change.

#### Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| id | uuid | No* | Workspace ID (either id or slug required) |
| slug | string | No* | Workspace slug to identify (either id or slug required) |
| name | string | No | New display name |
| description | string | No | New description |
| config | object | No | New config |
| tags | string[] | No | New tags |
| meta | object | No | New metadata |

#### Response

Returns the updated workspace object.

### Delete Workspace

Deletes a workspace by `id` or `slug`. This is a destructive operation.

#### Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| id | uuid | No* | Workspace ID (either id or slug required) |
| slug | string | No* | Workspace slug (either id or slug required) |

#### Response

``` json
{
  "success": true,
  "status": 200,
  "data": {
    "id": "uuid...",
    "slug": "my-org",
    "name": "My Organization"
  }
}
```

item.name: Accounts
item.description:
User account management. Accounts are global identities that can belong to multiple workspaces via memberships.

**Auth required:** Bearer token for all endpoints.

request.description:
### Create Account

Creates a new user account within a workspace. The email must be unique.

#### Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| email | string | Yes | Unique email address |
| password | string | Yes | Account password (hashed with Argon2) |
| workspace_id | uuid | Yes | The workspace to associate with |
| name | string | Yes | Display name |
| description | string | No | Optional description |
| avatar_url | string | No | Avatar image URL |
| tags | string[] | No | Tags for categorization |
| meta | object | No | Metadata (must include `schema_version`) |

#### Response

Returns the created account object.

### Describe Account

Retrieves an account by `id` or `email`.

#### Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| workspace_id | uuid | Yes | The workspace context |
| id | uuid | No* | Account ID (either id or email required) |
| email | string | No* | Account email (either id or email required) |

#### Response

Returns the full account object with `id`, `email`, `name`, `enabled`, `verified`, `created_at`, etc.

### List Accounts

Lists accounts in a workspace with optional filtering and pagination.

#### Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| workspace_id | uuid | Yes | The workspace context |
| filter | object | No | Filter with `tags` and `fields` |
| options | object | No | Pagination with `limit`, `offset`, `order_bys` |

#### Filter Fields (within `fields`)
- `id`: UUID
- `email`: string
- `name`: string
- `description`: string
- `avatar_url`: string
- `verified`: bool
- `enabled`: bool
- `created_by`: UUID
- `created_at`: datetime
- `updated_by`: UUID
- `updated_at`: datetime

#### Response

``` json
{
  "success": true,
  "status": 200,
  "data": {
    "accounts": [...],
    "metadata": { "total": 15, "count": 10, "offset": 0, "limit": 10, "order_bys": ["!created_at"] }
  }
}
```

### Update Account

Updates account fields. All fields except `workspace_id` are optional.

#### Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| workspace_id | uuid | Yes | The workspace context |
| id | uuid | No* | Account ID (either id or email required) |
| email | string | No* | Account email to identify (when not using id) |
| name | string | No | New display name |
| description | string | No | New description |
| avatar_url | string | No | New avatar URL |
| enabled | bool | No | Enable/disable account |
| verified | bool | No | Verify/unverify account |
| tags | string[] | No | New tags |
| meta | object | No | New metadata |

#### Response

Returns the updated account object.

### Delete Account

Deletes an account by `id` or `email`.

#### Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| workspace_id | uuid | Yes | The workspace context |
| id | uuid | No* | Account ID (either id or email required) |
| email | string | No* | Account email (either id or email required) |

#### Response

``` json
{
  "success": true,
  "status": 200,
  "data": {
    "id": "uuid..."
  }
}
```

item.name: Projects
item.description:
Project management within workspaces. Projects represent scoped work areas or applications.

**Auth required:** Bearer token for all endpoints.

request.description:
### Create Project

Creates a new project within a workspace. The name must be unique within the workspace.

#### Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| workspace_id | uuid | Yes | The parent workspace |
| name | string | Yes | Project name (unique per workspace) |
| code | string | No | Short code identifier |
| description | string | No | Optional description |
| config | object | Yes | Project configuration |
| tags | string[] | Yes | Tags for categorization |
| meta | object | Yes | Metadata |

#### Response

Returns the created project object.

### Describe Project

Retrieves a project by `id` or `code` within a workspace.

#### Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| workspace_id | uuid | Yes | The workspace context |
| id | uuid | No* | Project ID (either id or code required) |
| code | string | No* | Project code (either id or code required) |

#### Response

Returns the full project object.

### List Projects

Lists projects within a workspace with optional filtering and pagination.

#### Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| workspace_id | uuid | Yes | The workspace context |
| filter | object | No | Filter with `tags` and `fields` |
| options | object | No | Pagination with `limit`, `offset`, `order_bys` |

#### Filter Fields
- `id`: UUID
- `workspace_id`: UUID
- `name`: string
- `code`: string
- `description`: string

#### Response

``` json
{
  "success": true,
  "status": 200,
  "data": {
    "projects": [...],
    "metadata": { ... }
  }
}
```

### Update Project

Updates project fields. All fields except `workspace_id` are optional.

#### Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| workspace_id | uuid | Yes | The workspace context |
| id | uuid | No* | Project ID (either id or code required) |
| code | string | No* | Current project code to identify (when not using id) |
| name | string | No | New name |
| new_code | string | No | New code (to rename) |
| description | string | No | New description |
| config | object | No | New config |
| tags | string[] | No | New tags |
| meta | object | No | New metadata |

#### Response

Returns the updated project object.

### Delete Project

Deletes a project by `id` or `code`.

#### Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| workspace_id | uuid | Yes | The workspace context |
| id | uuid | No* | Project ID (either id or code required) |
| code | string | No* | Project code (either id or code required) |

#### Response

``` json
{
  "success": true,
  "status": 200,
  "data": {
    "id": "uuid...",
    "code": "web-app",
    "name": "Web Application"
  }
}
```

item.name: Roles
item.description:
Role-based access control (RBAC). Roles bundle permissions together.

**Auth required:** Bearer token for all endpoints.

request.description:
### Create Role

Creates a new role with associated permissions. The name must be unique within the workspace.

#### Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| workspace_id | uuid | Yes | The workspace context |
| name | string | Yes | Role name (unique per workspace) |
| description | string | No | Optional description |
| permission_ids | uuid[] | Yes | Permissions to attach to this role |
| tags | string[] | Yes | Tags |
| meta | object | Yes | Metadata |

#### Response

Returns the created role object with nested permissions.

### Describe Role

Retrieves a role by its ID.

#### Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| workspace_id | uuid | Yes | The workspace context |
| id | uuid | Yes | The role ID |

#### Response

Returns the role object with nested permissions.

### List Roles

Lists roles within a workspace with optional filtering and pagination.

#### Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| workspace_id | uuid | Yes | The workspace context |
| filter | object | No | Filter with `tags` and `fields` |
| options | object | No | Pagination with `limit`, `offset`, `order_bys` |

#### Filter Fields
- `id`: UUID
- `workspace_id`: UUID
- `name`: string
- `description`: string

#### Response

``` json
{
  "success": true,
  "status": 200,
  "data": {
    "roles": [...],
    "metadata": { ... }
  }
}
```

### Update Role

Updates role fields. All fields except `workspace_id` and `id` are optional.

#### Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| id | uuid | Yes | The role ID |
| workspace_id | uuid | Yes | The workspace context |
| name | string | No | New name |
| description | string | No | New description |
| permission_ids | uuid[] | No | Replace attached permissions |
| tags | string[] | No | New tags |
| meta | object | No | New metadata |

#### Response

Returns the updated role object.

### Delete Role

Deletes a role by ID.

#### Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| id | uuid | Yes | The role ID |
| workspace_id | uuid | Yes | The workspace context |

#### Response

``` json
{
  "success": true,
  "status": 200,
  "data": {
    "id": "uuid..."
  }
}
```

item.name: Permissions
item.description:
Fine-grained permission management. Permissions use `resource:action` format with wildcard support.

**Auth required:** Bearer token for all endpoints.

request.description:
### Create Permission

Creates a new permission in a workspace. The name must be unique within the workspace.

#### Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| workspace_id | uuid | Yes | The workspace context |
| name | string | Yes | Permission name (unique per workspace, e.g. "account:read") |
| code | string | No | Machine-readable code |
| description | string | No | Human-readable description |
| tags | string[] | Yes | Tags |
| meta | object | Yes | Metadata |

#### Permission Naming Convention
Permissions use `resource:action` format with wildcard support:
- `*` — all permissions
- `account:*` — all account actions
- `*:read` — read on any resource

#### Response

Returns the created permission object.

### Describe Permission

Retrieves a permission by `id` or `code`.

#### Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| workspace_id | uuid | Yes | The workspace context |
| id | uuid | No* | Permission ID (either id or code required) |
| code | string | No* | Permission code (either id or code required) |

#### Response

Returns the full permission object.

### List Permissions

Lists permissions within a workspace with optional filtering and pagination.

#### Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| workspace_id | uuid | Yes | The workspace context |
| filter | object | No | Filter with `tags` and `fields` |
| options | object | No | Pagination |

#### Filter Fields
- `id`: UUID
- `workspace_id`: UUID
- `name`: string
- `code`: string
- `description`: string

#### Response

``` json
{
  "success": true,
  "status": 200,
  "data": {
    "permissions": [...],
    "metadata": { ... }
  }
}
```

### Update Permission

Updates a permission's metadata fields.

#### Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| id | uuid | Yes | The permission ID |
| workspace_id | uuid | Yes | The workspace context |
| name | string | No | New name |
| code | string | No | New code |
| description | string | No | New description |
| tags | string[] | No | New tags |
| meta | object | No | New metadata |

#### Response

Returns the updated permission object.

### Delete Permission

Deletes a permission by ID.

#### Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| id | uuid | Yes | The permission ID |
| workspace_id | uuid | Yes | The workspace context |

#### Response

``` json
{
  "success": true,
  "status": 200,
  "data": {
    "id": "uuid..."
  }
}
```

item.name: Memberships
item.description:
Membership management linking accounts to workspaces or projects with assigned roles.

**Auth required:** Bearer token for all endpoints.

request.description:
### Create Membership

Creates a membership linking an account to a workspace or project with assigned roles.

#### Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| account_id | uuid | Yes | The account to link |
| workspace_id | uuid | Yes | The workspace context |
| scope | string | Yes | Either `"workspace"` or `"project"` |
| status | string | Yes | One of: `"invited"`, `"active"`, `"suspended"` |
| project_id | uuid | No | Required if scope is `"project"` |
| role_ids | uuid[] | Yes | Roles to assign |
| tags | string[] | Yes | Tags |
| meta | object | Yes | Metadata |

#### Response

Returns the created membership object with nested roles.

### Describe Membership

Retrieves a membership by ID.

#### Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| id | uuid | Yes | The membership ID |
| workspace_id | uuid | Yes | The workspace context |

#### Response

Returns the full membership object including `account_id`, `scope`, `status`, `project_id`, and nested `roles`.

### List Memberships

Lists memberships within a workspace with optional filtering and pagination.

#### Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| workspace_id | uuid | Yes | The workspace context |
| filter | object | No | Filter with `tags` and `fields` |
| options | object | No | Pagination |

#### Filter Fields
- `id`: UUID
- `account_id`: UUID
- `workspace_id`: UUID
- `scope`: string ("workspace" or "project")
- `status`: string ("invited", "active", "suspended")
- `project_id`: UUID

#### Response

``` json
{
  "success": true,
  "status": 200,
  "data": {
    "memberships": [...],
    "metadata": { ... }
  }
}
```

### Update Membership

Updates membership fields. All fields except `id` and `workspace_id` are optional.

#### Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| id | uuid | Yes | The membership ID |
| workspace_id | uuid | Yes | The workspace context |
| status | string | No | "invited", "active", or "suspended" |
| scope | string | No | "workspace" or "project" |
| project_id | uuid | No | Project ID (for project scope) |
| tags | string[] | No | New tags |
| meta | object | No | New metadata |

#### Response

Returns the updated membership object.

### Delete Membership

Deletes a membership by ID.

#### Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| id | uuid | Yes | The membership ID |
| workspace_id | uuid | Yes | The workspace context |

#### Response

``` json
{
  "success": true,
  "status": 200,
  "data": {
    "id": "uuid..."
  }
}
```

item.name: Credentials
item.description:
Authentication credential management. Credentials link accounts to authentication providers (local password, Google OAuth, GitHub, SSO, API keys).

Note: No create endpoint — credentials are created implicitly during account registration or OAuth flow.

**Auth required:** Bearer token for all endpoints.

request.description:
### Describe Credential

Retrieves a credential by ID.

#### Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| id | uuid | Yes | The credential ID |
| account_id | uuid | Yes | The owning account |
| workspace_id | uuid | Yes | The workspace context |
| provider_id | string | No | External provider ID |
| email | string | No | Associated email |

#### Response

Returns the credential object with `kind`, `provider`, `status`, `last_used_at`, etc.

### List Credentials

Lists credentials within a workspace with optional filtering.

#### Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| workspace_id | uuid | Yes | The workspace context |
| filter | object | No | Filter with `tags` and `fields` |
| options | object | No | Pagination |

#### Filter Fields
- `id`: UUID
- `account_id`: UUID
- `workspace_id`: UUID
- `kind`: string ("password", "oauth", "sso", "api_key")
- `provider`: string ("local", "google", "github")
- `status`: string ("active", "revoked", "pending")
- `provider_id`: string
- `email`: string

#### Response

``` json
{
  "success": true,
  "status": 200,
  "data": {
    "credentials": [...],
    "metadata": { ... }
  }
}
```

### Update Credential

Updates a credential's fields. All fields except `id`, `account_id`, and `workspace_id` are optional.

#### Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| id | uuid | Yes | The credential ID |
| account_id | uuid | Yes | The owning account |
| workspace_id | uuid | Yes | The workspace context |
| kind | string | No | "password", "oauth", "sso", "api_key" |
| provider | string | No | "local", "google", "github" |
| status | string | No | "active", "revoked", "pending" |
| provider_id | string | No | External provider ID |
| email | string | No | Email address |
| new_provider_id | string | No | New external provider ID |
| new_email | string | No | New associated email |
| secret | string | No | New password/secret |
| last_used_at | datetime | No | Last usage timestamp (RFC 3339) |
| tags | string[] | No | New tags |
| meta | object | No | New metadata |

#### Response

Returns the updated credential object.

### Delete Credential

Deletes a credential by ID.

#### Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| id | uuid | Yes | The credential ID |
| account_id | uuid | Yes | The owning account |
| workspace_id | uuid | Yes | The workspace context |
| provider_id | string | No | External provider ID |
| email | string | No | Associated email |

#### Response

``` json
{
  "success": true,
  "status": 200,
  "data": {
    "id": "uuid..."
  }
}
```

item.name: Tokens
item.description:
Token management for blacklisted/revoked tokens. Tokens are blacklisted as SHA-256 hashes.

Note: No create or update endpoints — tokens are created during authentication and listed/deleted for revocation.

**Auth required:** Bearer token for all endpoints.

request.description:
### Describe Token

Retrieves a blacklisted token entry by ID.

#### Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| id | uuid | Yes | The token entry ID |
| workspace_id | uuid | Yes | The workspace context |

#### Response

Returns the token entry with `kind` ("auth" or "password_reset"), `account_id`, `expires_at`, `reason`, etc.

### List Tokens

Lists blacklisted token entries within a workspace.

#### Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| workspace_id | uuid | Yes | The workspace context |
| filter | object | No | Filter with `tags` and `fields` |
| options | object | No | Pagination |

#### Filter Fields
- `id`: UUID
- `kind`: string ("auth", "password_reset")
- `account_id`: UUID
- `workspace_id`: UUID
- `reason`: string
- `expires_at`: datetime

#### Response

``` json
{
  "success": true,
  "status": 200,
  "data": {
    "tokens": [...],
    "metadata": { ... }
  }
}
```

### Delete Token

Removes a blacklisted token entry (un-revokes it).

#### Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| id | uuid | Yes | The token entry ID |
| workspace_id | uuid | Yes | The workspace context |

#### Response

``` json
{
  "success": true,
  "status": 200,
  "data": {
    "id": "uuid..."
  }
}
```
